Definition: from τόσος (so much; apparently from G3588 and G3739) and G3778 (including its variations); so vast as this, i.e. such (in quantity, amount, number of space):--as large, so great (long, many, much), these many.
BiblicalUsage: So much, so great, so many — the word measures what is before the eyes. Paul says there are so many kinds of voices in the world and none without signification, and Peter asks Sapphira whether they sold the land for so much, and she says yes, for so much.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the range runs from the many voices of the world to the one price that exposed a lie.
